entities.name: Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek
entities.description: The 4559 AR battle on Zendikar in which the Eldrazi titans were bound in leylines and destroyed.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan released on Zendikar, imprisoned briefly at Sea Gate and later destroyed.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan called by Ob Nixilis to rejoin Ulamog; destroyed with it.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who bound the titans with leylines and channeled mana to Chandra; she stays on Zendikar as its guardian.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who ignited the leylines to destroy the titans.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who guided the binding plan and later left Zendikar to gather intelligence.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who rallied the Zendikari defenders.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who turned against the Gatewatch, fearing the binding would kill Zendikar, then walked away.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who advised Jace and was furious when the titans were killed.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker whose interference ended the first imprisonment and who called Kozilek to Ulamog.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers that led the attack on the titans.

entities.name: General Tazri
entities.description: Leader of the regrouped Sea Gate survivors.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor ambusher among the survivors.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A ruin diver among the survivors.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the titans were destroyed.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: Site of the hedron imprisonment of Ulamog.

entities.name: Halimar Basin
entities.description: Site on Tazeem where the final battle occurred.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: Shelter for Zendikar's remaining survivors.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker involved in the titans' imprisonment or release.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker involved in the titans' imprisonment or release.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker involved in the titans' imprisonment or release.

events.summary: Jace and Nissa imprison Ulamog in a hedron network at Sea Gate on Ugin's advice, but Ob Nixilis's interference makes it fail and he calls Kozilek to join Ulamog.
events.quote: That effort was briefly successful but ultimately failed due to interference by Ob Nixilis

events.summary: The titans head to Halimar Basin; the Sea Gate survivors regroup and are joined by Kiora.
events.quote: The survivors of the Sea Gate effort regrouped under General Tazri

events.summary: The Gatewatch chooses a direct attack: Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
events.quote: Gideon Jura rallied the Zendikari defenders to lead the titans into the ambush

events.summary: The binding locks and the titans begin to tear apart; Chandra asks to attack but Jace insists on his plan.
events.quote: but Jace insisted on proceeding with his original plan

events.summary: Kiora betrays the group, lifting the Halimar Sea to hurl at Nissa; Jace deflects it onto the Eldrazi spawn.
Chandra attacks and Nissa channels leyline mana to her, igniting the leylines and destroying both titans.
events.quote: The titans were destroyed in an enormous explosion.

events.summary: Kiora walks away from the battlefield.
events.quote: Kiora walked away from the scene of the battle

events.summary: Ugin confronts Jace, furious the titans were killed, and warns of unknown consequences.
events.quote: Ugin arrived and confronted Jace, furious that the titans had been killed despite his warning.

events.summary: Jace and Gideon resolve to leave Zendikar to gather intelligence, while Nissa stays as its guardian.
events.quote: Nissa committed to staying on Zendikar as its guardian.

relations.note: Helped destroy the titans by channeling leyline mana.
relations.quote: helped Chandra Nalaar to draw a vast amount of mana and ignite those leylines, killing the titans

relations.note: His interference caused the imprisonment effort to fail.
relations.quote: ultimately failed due to interference by Ob Nixilis

relations.note: Advised Jace on imprisoning rather than killing the titan.
Turned against the group and attacked Nissa with the sea's water.
relations.quote: attempted to throw that volume at Nissa
